author: Bill Ferguson
name: dbmaint
description: Scans the darktable library database for missing images and film rolls and lets the user remove the stale entries.
description-extensive: Over time your darktable catalog can accumulate references to photos or folders that no longer exist on disk. This tool scans for those missing images and film rolls, shows you what it found, and lets you decide whether to clean them out. It helps keep your library tidy and accurate.
